waive.TypeOK: Shape check only: no behaviour change breaks it without also breaking a property above it, and TLC already stops with an evaluation error when an action leaves a variable unspecified.

mutations.name: drop-lock-guard
mutations.why: Acquire no longer waits for a free lock (the UseLock guard removed): two threads can sit inside the critical section at once.

mutations.name: drop-read
mutations.why: Read no longer copies the counter, so every thread writes 1 even though exclusion still holds: the final count is wrong without any overlap, which only NoLostUpdate can notice.

mutations.name: remove-fairness
mutations.why: Without WF on Step a thread may stop forever before it finishes, so AllFinish must fail by stuttering.
